title: Where Does Physical RSI Come From? Scaling LLM Robotic Policies

beats.text: Before you deploy your next physical policy, see how Where Does Physical RSI Come From? Scaling LLM Robotic Policies unlocks 89.4% better precision.

beats.text: The villain? The Physical Barrel Hypothesis. Your robot's improvement is capped by its weakest capability, like a leaking stave.
beats.visual_focus: A barrel with uneven wooden staves leaking water.

beats.text: We introduce PhysRSI-Eval. It tracks five axes: first-attempt performance, efficiency, success, budget, and improvement from failure.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook was solid—it hit a real pain point in robotics that I've seen in labs. I didn't swipe because you didn't waste time with a 'Hey guys' intro. Beat 4 was the only part where I had to pause; 'negative constraints' is a bit vague. Are you masking the loss function or just hard-coding a penalty in the reward function? If you clarify that, it's a 10/10.

thriller_metadata.physical_analogy: A leaking barrel where the lowest stave dictates the maximum water level, regardless of how much you pour in.
thriller_metadata.paradigm_shift: Moving from static benchmarks to dynamic, history-aware physical adaptation.
